item.title: Imouto to Yaritai Koto no Subete "Gokun...... Nee, Nandemo Suru kara, Kore, Motto Choudai, Onii-chan"
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: WitchFlame
  • 発売日: 2018-11-30
  • スコア: 7.1/10 (58 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 妹とヤリたいことのすべて「ごくん……ねぇ、なんでもするから、これ、もっとちょうだい、お兄ちゃん」
  • 英語名: Imouto to Yaritai Koto no Subete “Gokun…… Nee, Nandemo Suru kara, Kore, Motto Choudai, Onii-chan”

あらすじ

Tatsuma and his three younger sisters; Kokoro, Hinami and Shizuku lost their parents and live together. Tatsuma never leaves his room however. He refuses to do household chores and refuses to work. Finally having enough of a freeloading brother the sisters kick him out. They can do without him. However the next month the money from their inheritance stops being deposited in the bank. Angry that he would steal money from them the oldest sister confronts him. “What have you done with our parents money!”

  • 英語名: Dokusen Saimin “Watashi o Suki ni Shite Ii kara, Ano Ko mo Mechakucha ni Shite!”

あらすじ

One day, the protagonist, Kannagi Kouya (※surname and first name can be changed), was approached by a transfer student and classmate, Fuchigami Fuyune, with a strange proposal.

“I want you to ruin Mikumo Suzuka, another classmate of ours. In exchange, you can do whatever you want with my body, even though I don’t like it.”

item.title: Dokusenjima "Anta o Suki ni Naru Kurai Nara Haramasareta Hou ga Mashi yo!"
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: WitchFlame
  • 発売日: 2017-04-28
  • スコア: 7.109999999999999/10 (53 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 独占島「あんたを好きになるくらいなら孕まされた方がマシよ！」
  • 英語名: Dokusenjima “Anta o Suki ni Naru Kurai Nara Haramasareta Hou ga Mashi yo!”

あらすじ

The protagonist has a special ability: “Forced Love”. Anyone in the area of effect will have more and more goodwill towards him and ultimately, becomes an obedient slave. Using this power, he acquires many benefits from powerful and wealthy people.

One summer, he decides to invite 4 girls to his own paradise island. However, it’s a trap. In order to leave this uninhabited island, they must bear his child. “Either you leave as a mother or become my woman. There’s no time to think!”

item.title: Shinsou Parallel Paradox -Heikou Sekai no Risoukyou-
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: WitchFlame
  • 発売日: 2016-03-25
  • スコア: 6.67/10 (82 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 深層パラレルパラドックス －並行世界の理想郷－
  • 英語名: Shinsou Parallel Paradox -Heikou Sekai no Risoukyou-

あらすじ

The protagonist is somebody who is capable of travelling between parallel worlds. However, because he’s been using this power for as long as he can remember, he doesn’t think of his ability as something special.

But one day, he realises that he doesn’t have counterparts in each of the parallel worlds. Believing that the worlds revolve around him, he gains a superiority complex and decides to go and satisfy his desires.

item.title: Hitomi no Rakuin 4 ~Etsujoku no Soushin Kaizou~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: WitchFlame
  • 発売日: 2014-05-30
  • スコア: 6.45/10 (44 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 瞳の烙淫4 ～悦辱の操心改造～
  • 英語名: Hitomi no Rakuin 4 Etsujoku no Soushin Kaizou

あらすじ

The protagonist, Sawamatsu Yuuki (name changeable), possessed a unique ability: the power to induce illusions in those he locked eyes with.

This extraordinary ability caught the attention of the head of the prestigious conglomerate, Kanba, who quickly recruited him. Thanks to the sheer utility of his power, Yuuki was often used as a convenient tool for the company’s benefit. Yet, at the same time, he was trusted and given opportunities to fully utilize his otherwise overwhelming ability. As a close aide, he found a sense of fulfillment in his role.

item.description:

  • スコア: 6.659999999999999/10 (50 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 瞳の烙淫3 ～双眸の洗脳調教～
  • 英語名: Hitomi no Rakuin 3 Soubou no Sennou Choukyou

あらすじ

Reihou Academy.

Until a few years ago, it was a prestigious all-girls school, the kind you’d call a “young ladies’ academy.” But now, it’s co-ed.

Even so, the majority of students are still girls.

The protagonist, Sakurami Souya (first and last name changeable), enrolled in this school for one simple reason: it was close to home.

item.title: Hitomi no Rakuin ~Inbaku no Mesu Dorei~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: WitchFlame
  • 発売日: 2008-03-28
  • スコア: 6.63/10 (26 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 瞳の烙淫～淫縛の牝奴隷～
  • 英語名: Hitomi no Rakuin Inbaku no Mesu Dorei

あらすじ

Main character’s sister finally returns home after long hospitalization, but at the same time parents go overseas leaving children to live alone. Sister asks to check on her classmate at night classroom, and protagonist witness classmate having sex there. Sister meets brother with red eyes and cries that she feels lonely. Peaceful school life changes dramatically since this day.
